assets.name: Warehouse guide sign
assets.note: 6 x 2.6 x 0.3 m panel, bottom z=4.2 m; 7 m rear masts. Front normal faces Blender -Y and 20 degrees upward; arrow points +X. Three stacked boxes, 22 bulbs (diameter 0.18 m). Panel front center (game local XYZ): [0.0, 5.4945, 0.141]. Front outward normal (game local): [0, 0.342020, 0.939693]; place the game's warm OmniLight outward from this surface. No model lights or physics. Box collision covers the two legs, their feet and the cross braces between them (5.3 m wide, 2.4 m tall); the overhead panel must not block movement.
